outline: This course examines global brand management from business, legal, and strategic perspectives. It focuses on brand development strategy, brand equity and valuation, trademark protection, corporate governance and brand management, and intellectual property and brand licensing. Through lectures, academic papers, case studies, oral presentations, and project-based learning, students will develop the ability to analyze brand-management issues and formulate effective global brand strategies.

Week 8 — Ch 7 Branding in the Digital Era
Week 9 — Ch 8 Leveraging Secondary Brand Associations to Build Brand Equity
Week 10 — Ch 9 Developing a Brand Equity Measurement and Management System
Week 11 — Ch 10 Measuring Sources of Brand Equity: Capturing Customer Mind-Set
Week 12 — Ch 11 Measuring Outcomes of Brand Equity: Capturing Market Performance
Week 13 — Ch 12 Designing and Implementing Brand Architecture Strategies
Week 14 — Ch 13 Introducing and Naming New Products and Brand Extensions
Week 15 — Ch 14 Managing Brands Over Time
Week 16 — Ch 15 Managing Brands Over Geographic Boundaries and Market Segments; Ch 16 Closing Observations
